column1: # Rows are `ok`-line durations (s) under -race from merge_group run
# 45186345093 (2026-11-23) on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, measured under the
# previous table's packing (e2e, pkg/server and internal/fswatch on one
# shard), so treat them as relative weights, not walls; refresh when the mix
# drifts. Packages under 10 s are left out: unlisted packages weigh 1, so a
# stale or missing row only degrades the balance — it never errors.
# race-shard leaves out e2e (under -race in test-e2e) and pkg/sandbox/kubernetes
# (under -race in test-native-exec), so neither carries a row here.
